description: This source file contains functions related to detecting and handling 'breaks' in diff pairs within Git's diffcore subsystem, including logic for breaking and merging broken file pairs based on edit scores and size thresholds.

methods.name: int should_break(struct repository * r,struct diff_filespec * src,struct diff_filespec * dst,int break_score,int * merge_score_p)
methods.description: Determines whether a pair of files should be considered sufficiently different to break into separate delete and create pairs based on size and content differences.

methods.name: void diffcore_break(struct repository * r,int break_score)
methods.description: Analyzes queued diffs to decide and break up large or significant changes into separate delete and create pairs, based on configurable break score thresholds.

methods.name: void merge_broken(struct diff_filepair * p,struct diff_filepair * pp,struct diff_queue_struct * outq)
methods.description: Merges two broken diff pairs back into a single pair if they are compatible, facilitating cleanup of broken change pairs.

methods.name: void diffcore_merge_broken(void)
methods.description: Iterates through the queue of diff pairs and merges broken pairs that can be combined back, restoring some combined view of the changes.
